现在让我创建一个权限修复脚本：

---

```diff
- 
+ -- 修复排班管理模块权限配置脚本
+ -- 执行此脚本后需要重新登录才能看到排班管理菜单
+ 
+ USE jsh_erp;
+ 
+ -- 1. 补全排班管理子功能权限（如果不存在）
+ INSERT IGNORE INTO `jsh_function` (`number`, `name`, `parent_number`, `url`, `component`, `state`, `sort`, `enabled`, `type`, `push_btn`, `icon`, `delete_flag`) VALUES
+ ('000802', '排班新增', '0008', '', '', 0, '020', 1, '电脑版', '', '', '0'),
+ ('000803', '排班编辑', '0008', '', '', 0, '030', 1, '电脑版', '', '', '0'),
+ ('000804', '排班删除', '0008', '', '', 0, '040', 1, '电脑版', '', '', '0'),
+ ('000805', '排班统计', '0008', '', '', 0, '050', 1, '电脑版', '', '', '0'),
+ ('000806', '薪酬计算', '0008', '', '', 0, '060', 1, '电脑版', '', '', '0');
+ 
+ -- 2. 更新排班管理主菜单，确保component正确
+ UPDATE `jsh_function` SET 
+     `component` = '/schedule/ScheduleList',
+     `icon` = 'schedule',
+     `enabled` = 1
+ WHERE `number` = '0008';
+ 
+ -- 3. 为管理员角色(ID=63)分配所有排班管理权限
+ INSERT IGNORE INTO `jsh_user_business` (`type`, `key_id`, `value`, `btn_str`, `tenant_id`) 
+ SELECT 'UserRole', f.id, '63', '[\"1\",\"2\",\"3\",\"4\",\"5\"]', 63
+ FROM `jsh_function` f 
+ WHERE f.number IN ('0008', '000801', '000802', '000803', '000804', '000805', '000806');
+ 
+ -- 4. 验证权限配置
+ SELECT 
+     f.number,
+     f.name,
+     f.parent_number,
+     f.component,
+     f.url,
+     CASE WHEN ub.id IS NOT NULL THEN '已分配' ELSE '未分配' END as permission_status
+ FROM `jsh_function` f
+ LEFT JOIN `jsh_user_business` ub ON f.id = ub.key_id AND ub.type = 'UserRole' AND ub.value = '63'
+ WHERE f.number LIKE '0008%'
+ ORDER BY f.number;
+ 
+ -- 5. 检查排班相关表是否存在
+ SELECT 
+     TABLE_NAME,
+     TABLE_COMMENT
+ FROM information_schema.TABLES 
+ WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'jsh_erp' 
+ AND TABLE_NAME LIKE 'jsh_schedule%';
+ 
+ -- 执行完成后的说明
+ SELECT '权限修复完成！请重新登录系统，排班管理菜单将出现在左侧导航栏中。' as message; 
```
